I have completed all tasks specified in [`TASK.md`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/01-feature-building/TASK.md). The dependency-aware job scheduler [`plan_jobs`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/01-feature-building/jobqueue.py#L51-L136) was implemented in [`jobqueue.py`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/01-feature-building/jobqueue.py) using Kahn's topological sort algorithm powered by a min-heap from Python's standard library `heapq`, selecting higher priority jobs first and breaking ties deterministically by original input order. Full input validation and DFS-based cycle diagnostics were added to report the exact cycle chain and involved IDs upon circular dependency detection, all while preserving the immutability of the supplied job objects and dependency collections. The test suite in [`test_jobqueue.py`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/01-feature-building/test_jobqueue.py) was expanded to 25 unit tests covering edge cases including diamond dependencies, dynamic readiness preemption, disconnected graphs, negative priorities, duplicate dependency definitions, self/multi-node cycles, immutability, streaming generators, and input validation errors, and the design and verification were documented in [`RESPONSE.md`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/01-feature-building/RESPONSE.md).
